Asset type: opaque PNG game surface texture, exactly front-facing orthographic rectangular vending-machine FRONT PANEL only for SIGNAL / 47, a stylized low-poly Three.js game set in New Mexico in 1986. This is a material graphic applied to a 0.74m by 1.48m plane, not a scene, product photograph or mockup. Style: modest worn 1980s snack-and-drink vending machine, intentionally simplified low-poly game-art appearance, broad planar graphic forms, restrained hand-painted wear, matte charcoal blue-gray body (#20262c), dull beige-gray coin mechanism. No glossy science fiction. Uniform neutral diffuse color; no lighting gradients or specular reflections. Follow this precise layout in the final 512x1024 coordinate space: a tall rectangular glass display window at x=28..372, y=28..788, occupying the upper left two-thirds; thin dark window rim and quiet pale blue-gray interior, showing six compact rows of anonymous simplified cans and snack bags on thin horizontal shelves, about five items per row. Also keep the narrow space directly below the display window plain and unmarked. The blank bottom label field must be empty and unobstructed, NOT replaced by vents, grooves or an extra slot. Simple subtle dry scuffs around the outer edges, no strong stains. No text of ANY kind anywhere in the image: no letters, no numbers, no words, no labels, no brand marks, no logo, no price signs, no barcode, no symbols, no UI, no decorative title, no watermark. All lettering including the machine's title will be added separately in code. Opaque image; no transparency, no checkerboard, no border outside the front panel.
